title: Shape Holomorphy of the Helmholtz Calderón Projector and the Maxwell EFIE on $C^{1,1}$ Surfaces and Screens
summary: We establish the holomorphic dependence of the Helmholtz Calderón projector on closed $C^{1,1}$ surfaces and of the operator associated with the Maxwell electric field integral equation (EFIE) on closed and open surfaces of the same regularity. More precisely, after transporting the boundary integral operators (BIOs) to fixed reference spaces, we prove that the resulting maps admit bounded holomorphic extensions to complex neighborhoods of compact sets of admissible boundary transformations, a property referred to as shape holomorphy.
